olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $\{1,\ldots,1998\}$ is partitioned into pairs $\{a_i,b_i\}$ with $|a_i-b_i|\in\{1,6\}$. Prove $|a_1-b_1|+\cdots+|a_{999}-b_{999}|$ ends in digit 9.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1998

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: $C_1,C_2$ are concentric circles. From $A\in C_1$ draw tangent $AB$ to $C_2$; $C$ = second intersection of $AB$ with $C_1$; $D$ = midpoint of $AB$. A line through $A$ meets $C_2$ at $E,F$ so that perpendicular bisectors of $DE$ and $CF$ meet on $AB$ at $M$. Find $AM/MC$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1998

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: Let $a_0,\ldots,a_n\in(0,\pi/2)$ with $\sum\tan(a_i-\pi/4)\geq n-1$. Prove $\prod\tan a_i\geq n^{n+1}$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1998

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: A $98\times 98$ chessboard: clicking any rectangle switches all its colors. Find the minimum clicks to make it all one color.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1998

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: For each $n\geq 2$, prove there is a set $S$ of $n$ integers with $(a-b)^2\mid ab$ for every distinct $a,b\in S$.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1998

olympiad_full_name: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad
statement: For $n\geq 5$, find the largest $k$ such that some convex $n$-gon $A_1\cdots A_n$ has exactly $k$ of the quadrilaterals $A_iA_{i+1}A_{i+2}A_{i+3}$ with an inscribed circle.
source: United States of America Mathematical Olympiad 1998
